2. Postictal/status epilepticus–related cortical cytotoxic edema (seizure-induced brain injury)
3. Acute toxic leukoencephalopathy from other inhaled/illicit toxins (e.g., other synthetic drugs)
4. Posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) with atypical diffuse involvement
5. Viral encephalitis (e.g., HSV) with bilateral cortical involvement (less likely given absent fever and presentation)
